summary: Correct, minimal one-line fix that preserves a caller-supplied empty_label when radio_fields is set, falling back to _('None') only when unset. Resolves the reported issue without regression risk.

issues.description: Uses single quotes (kwargs.get('empty_label'), _('None')) while the surrounding code and Django's Black style use double quotes; Black would reformat to double quotes.

`or` treats an intentionally empty-string empty_label as falsy and replaces it with _('None'); an explicit `'empty_label' in kwargs` check would be stricter, though this edge case is negligible in practice.
